t: The Erbauer multi-material cutting blade set provides comprehensive versatility with 15 pieces designed for wood, metal and plastic applications on multi-tools. This kit includes HCS saw blades, bi-metal options, HSS blades, and carbide grit triangular and half-moon blades for demanding cuts. Stainless steel scrapers and curved alternatives handle finishing work, whilst the adaptors and fixing pin connections ensure secure, reliable attachment. Whether tackling renovation projects, maintenance work or precision cutting tasks, this mixed blade set eliminates the need for multiple purchases.
